title: Multiplication by a positive integer on an injective abelian sheaf is epic
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site in the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention], and let $I$ be an injective object [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of the category $\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For every positive integer $n$, multiplication by $n$, namely $n\cdot\mathrm{id}_I:I\to I$, is an epimorphism in $\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C)$.
